row.notes: In Game_TheatreRows_GetRow: imul r14,rdi,0x4c8 (7 bytes, 4C 69 F7 C8 04 00 00) at the merge of the append path (mov rbx,[r13+0x110] at 0x141f0b99b) and the in-range path (ja 0x141f0b9a2 at 0x141f0b208), right after mov [rsp+0x30],edi stores the index as the row's slot_id value. rdi = the index, rbx = rows begin [r13+0x110], r13 = the rows holder (rows 0x4c8 bytes at [+0x110..+0x118]). r14 is the row offset every later read uses ([rbx+r14+0xd0/0xf0/0x110/0x130/0x150] and the return rbx+r14 at 0x141f0bbab); rdi is next written at 0x141f0b9e9 (mov edi,eax) and read only for the slot_id store before the site, so changing rdi at the site moves the row and keeps slot_id. Core's theatre rows guard points rdi at the last row when rdi >= count. Not a branch target (all targets of 0x141f0b160..0x141f0bbcd listed by own capstone sweep: none in 0x141f0b9a7..0x141f0b9aa; 0x141f0b9a2 is the ja target).
